description: This file defines interfaces and a generator for creating tabular representations of Kubernetes objects, including the HumanReadableGenerator implementation, handling table generation, and registration of print handlers.

classes.name: HumanReadableGenerator
classes.description: Implementation of TableGenerator and PrintHandler for generating Kubernetes resource tables with customizable print functions.

methods.name: GenerateTable
methods.description: Generates a metav1.Table for a given runtime.Object using registered handlers, applying options for headers and column width.

methods.name: TableHandler
methods.description: Registers a print function with specified column definitions for a particular object type.

methods.name: ValidateRowPrintHandlerFunc
methods.description: Validates that a print function has the correct signature for printing table rows.

methods.name: NewTableGenerator
methods.description: Creates a new instance of HumanReadableGenerator with an initialized handler map.

methods.name: With
methods.description: Adds builder functions to modify the HumanReadableGenerator instance.

search-terms: Go interface for Kubernetes resource tables
